tagline: Resize images by exact pixels or percentage, right in your browser
pageDescription: Resize any image to exact dimensions or by percentage with this free online Image Resizer. Set a target width or height with aspect ratio locked, or scale by a percentage, and export as PNG, JPG or WebP. Everything runs locally in your browser — your images are never uploaded to a server, so they stay private. Perfect for social media sizes, thumbnails, avatars and web assets. No signup, no watermarks, no file-size limits.

instructions.title: How to resize an image

steps.title: Upload your image
steps.description: Drag and drop an image onto the upload area or click to browse. Its current dimensions appear.

steps.title: Choose pixels or percentage
steps.description: Switch between exact pixel dimensions and a percentage scale, depending on how you want to resize.

steps.title: Set the new size
steps.description: Enter a width or height (the other follows when aspect ratio is locked), or drag the percentage slider.

steps.title: Pick an output format
steps.description: Keep PNG for lossless quality, choose JPG for smaller photos, or WebP for the best size-to-quality balance.

steps.title: Resize and download
steps.description: Click Resize image, preview the result with its new dimensions and size, then download.

proTips: Keep the aspect lock on to avoid stretched images
Enter only a width (or only a height) and the other is computed for you
Use percentage mode to scale down uniformly without doing the math
WebP usually gives the smallest file at the same visual quality
Upscaling above 100% can't add detail — it only enlarges pixels
Need a smaller file at the same size? Use the Image Compressor
troubleshooting: Image looks stretched: turn on Lock aspect ratio
Result is blurry: you upscaled beyond the original resolution
File is still large: switch format to JPG or WebP, or compress it
Nothing loads: make sure the file is a real image, not renamed
Transparency lost: export as PNG or WebP, not JPG
